# Results

Status: **positive**. The 0.03125-step phase scan and the PR #72 donor overlay
produced 24 complete groups that are strictly better than the official
`upstream/merge` baseline in both decimal-string and pandas round-trip
transports.

## Baseline

| item | value |
|---|---|
| merge commit | `2714efd981190e83db228f1b0a4f300de4e4122a` |
| file | `merged-22.15248431101.csv` |
| sha256 | `5c9bad10cc9a74147d4423ab2b134915156da1f7814474ca224d8c69ffd32db4` |
| official score | `22.15248431100757` |
| accepted / missing / rejected | `1000 / 0 / 0` |

The PR #72 donor overlay was used only to realize source geometry. Every final
comparison used the untouched official baseline above.

## Scan

Eight independent processes ran the nine PR #72 groups at step `0.03125` with
all BLAS, OpenMP, NumExpr, and VECLIB thread counts fixed to one.

| item | value |
|---|---|
| phase lattices | eight Cartesian/diagonal offsets |
| rows per phase | 9 |
| gadgets | 240940 |
| distinct oriented shapes | 9774 |
| wall time | 2847.1 s (47 min 27.1 s), slowest worker |
| Pareto library | 1243 records |
| sanitized library | 1229 records |

The exact seam DP evaluated all 555 reachable cells and reported 52 strict
predictions. Rebuilding those predictions yielded 24 complete groups that
survived certification in both transports.
